name: How does a custom tub-to-shower conversion differ from a standard prefabricated kit?

mainEntity.name: How does a custom tub-to-shower conversion differ from a standard prefabricated kit?

acceptedAnswer.text: A custom tub-to-shower conversion offers superior design flexibility and material quality compared to a standard prefabricated kit. With a custom approach, you can select specific tile designs, niche placements, bench seating, fixture styles, and precise dimensions that perfectly fit your bathroom layout and aesthetic preferences. Prefabricated kits often limit choices to standard sizes and finishes. AKN Design Group specializes in customized renovations, ensuring your new shower integrates flawlessly with your overall home design and enhances long-term value, rather than a generic, off-the-shelf solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom conversions offer greater design flexibility and material choices, tailored to your space, unlike restrictive prefabricated kits.
